subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing an unreliable narrator and how it affects a reader's interpretation of events
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a narrator's claims to other evidence within a text to spot inconsistencies
exercise.pictorial: Student matches clues in a narrator's account to signs of unreliability
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a given narrator may be unreliable and how that affects interpretation of the story

misconception_flags: accepts a narrator's account entirely at face value despite clear textual signs of unreliability

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
